## Checklist
- [ ] Branched from `develop` and follows naming convention
- [ ] Commits are signed and follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing locally
- [ ] No secrets, keys, or `.env` files committed

## AI Assistance
- [ ] Not AI-assisted
- [ ] AI-assisted — if checked, the section below must be completed by the **reviewer**:
  - [ ] Logic verified — the change does what the PR claims, not merely compiles
  - [ ] No hallucinated APIs — all packages, functions, and flags verified to exist
  - [ ] No unvetted dependencies — any `go.mod` change has written justification
  - [ ] No leaked context or secrets — no credentials, internal paths, or prompt
        content carried into code, comments, or commit messages
